review.use_summary: Inferred and subtracted ambient RNA contamination from each scRNA-seq expression matrix using CellBender after STARsolo alignment and quantification.
review.implementation_scope_note: The CellBender release and fitting parameters are unstated. Souporcell donor assignment, Scrublet doublet calling and gene/cell QC are separate downstream steps; STARsolo rather than Cell Ranger supplied the counts.

review.use_summary: Checked possible ambient RNA contamination with CellBender within the snRNA-seq quality-control pipeline.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph reports a contamination check, without a CellBender release, fitting options or an explicit statement that corrected counts replaced all input counts. Gene/UMI/MALAT1 and donor QC thresholds are separate operations.

review.use_summary: Used CellBender 0.2.0 for background correction and cell calling in mouse embryo, human brain, tonsil and melanoma; expected cells followed Cell Ranger calls and 40,000 droplets were included, with learning rate 0.00005 when default cell probabilities were inadequate. The same processing was applied to multiome gene-expression counts.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is the reported historical 0.2.0 algorithm and a conditional learning-rate adjustment, not a current-runtime equivalence claim. Downstream spatial barcode matching and inferCNV reuse corrected counts/cell calls; Cell Ranger read processing, Seurat and spatial analysis remain separate.

review.use_summary: Removed ambient RNA from pooled gel bead-in-emulsions with CellBender 0.3.2 remove-background before downstream oRG scRNA-seq analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: Cell Ranger multi alignment/quantification, scDblFinder doublet scoring and Seurat normalization, cell-cycle regression and clustering are distinct. The CellBender fitting parameters are not reported here.

review.use_summary: Processed raw human scRNA-seq gene-expression matrices with CellBender 0.1.0 to remove ambient RNA before DoubletDetection and SCANPY analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: The historical 0.1.0 release is explicit; modern CellBender execution cannot be labeled reproduction of this older algorithm. Doublet removal, QC, Harmony, Leiden, expression testing and gene scores are downstream tools.

review.use_summary: Removed ambient RNA and other background from Cell Ranger count matrices with CellBender 0.3.0 using 150 epochs, false-positive rate 0.01 and learning rate 0.0001.
review.implementation_scope_note: Seurat integration, scDblFinder doublet detection and subsequent nucleus/gene/mitochondrial filters are separate. These parameters describe CellBender 0.3.0; exact sample matrices and runtime dependencies are additional inputs.

review.use_summary: Used the reported CellBender v.3-alpha during brain-wide snRNA-seq preprocessing after intron-inclusive Cell Ranger alignment, described as removing cells contaminated with ambient RNA.
review.implementation_scope_note: Retain the literal 3-alpha version label and the authors' cell-removal wording. The exact alpha commit, options and distinction between corrected counts and cell exclusion are unstated; do not normalize this to stable 0.3.0 or infer an independent contamination-cell threshold.

review.use_summary: Removed ambient RNA from each snRNA-seq sample with CellBender 0.2.1 remove-background using reported default parameters, before merging and downstream Seurat processing.
review.implementation_scope_note: The historical release is explicit. Mitochondrial/gene-count filtering, normalization, PCA, Louvain and UMAP belong to downstream Seurat steps and are not CellBender options.

review.use_summary: Quantified and corrected ambient RNA with CellBender 0.2.0 remove-background in Parse-derived snRNA-seq count matrices; also corrected ambient RNA per sample while uniformly reprocessing three published datasets quantified with kallisto bustools.
review.implementation_scope_note: Input quantification differs between new and reprocessed data. The new-data release is 0.2.0, while the reprocessing paragraph does not restate a release or full options. Scrublet, percentile QC and downstream SCANPY/Harmony are separate steps.

supporting_evidence.section: Methods / Reprocessing publicly available single-nucleus gene expression datasets

review.use_summary: Reused published DCM-versus-control differential-expression results derived from CellBender-adjusted counts, requiring adjusted two-sided P below 0.05 and absence of the published background-contamination flag for that source dataset.
review.implementation_scope_note: This paragraph establishes reuse of previously analyzed results, not a new CellBender run. The contamination flag and transcriptome-wide P threshold govern published DE-result selection, not CellBender false-positive rate. The release and original fitting parameters are unstated.

review.use_summary: Initially assessed ambient RNA and random barcode-swapping contamination with CellBender 0.4.0 and reported no significant ambient contamination; a separate SoupX analysis supported that assessment.
review.implementation_scope_note: The source reports a null contamination assessment, not evidence that all matrices were denoised with CellBender. SoupX 1.6.2 is a distinct validation method; CellBender fitting options are unstated.

review.use_summary: Applied CellBender 0.1.0 remove-background to raw PBMC droplet count matrices to remove cell-free ambient RNA and call cells before per-cell filtering and doublet removal.
review.implementation_scope_note: Cell Ranger/STAR quantification, UMI/gene/mitochondrial/hemoglobin QC and Scrublet/scds doublet detection remain separate. The historical CellBender version is explicit but its fit parameters are not given.

review.use_summary: Removed ambient RNA using CellBender 0.2.0 with expected cells 10,000, 50,000 included droplets, false-positive rate 0.01, 150 epochs and default learning rate; manually inspected per-sample learning curves.
review.implementation_scope_note: The reported fit uses a historical release and requires the original unfiltered count matrices. Cell Ranger expression quantification and STARsolo spliced/unspliced/ambiguous matrices are distinct upstream products; no automatic convergence certificate is implied by manual review.
